events.title: Version 0.4.3: Bushes, new bridges and a smoother tutorial
events.summary: A nice update for the demo, just in time for Next Fest. Highlights A smoother tutorial. It flows better from start to finish, and either bridge works for the river crossing. Bushes, and a bridge overhaul. Plant waist-high bushes, and build Arch or Flat bridges in two clicks, at any length. Unplayable lies. events.title: Demo 0.4.2: Anonymous play stats, with an off switch
events.summary: A small update with one change worth knowing about for full transparency. New Anonymous play stats, with an off switch. The game now sends Steam a few anonymous numbers, like how far people get in the tutorial and how long they spend building, so we can see what to improve. No personal data is collected: no names, no courses, no chat. Steam adds the numbers up across every player, and we only ever see the totals. events.title: Version 0.4.1: Now on Mac, plus Short Rough and reeds
events.summary: The demo now runs on Mac! This update also adds Short Rough, reeds for your ponds and a friendlier water tool, plus a handful of fixes. Added macOS support. The demo now runs on Macs through Steam, both Apple Silicon and Intel, and Early Access will too when it starts on 10 November. Cmd works where Windows uses Ctrl, trackpad scroll and pinch zoom the camera smoothly, and Option + drag spins it around. events.title: Join the Golf Course Architect Tycoon Discord
events.summary: I've started a Discord for Golf Course Architect Tycoon! Come share your courses, ask questions, or tell me how the demo went. I'll also share updates and what I'm working on. Join the Discord here If you've built a hole you're proud of, I'd love to see it. And if something confused you in your first ten minutes, I'd really like to hear about that too. Steam discussions are still a great place for questions and feedback, so use whichever you prefer. Thanks for playing, Greg

events.title: Demo update 0.3.1
events.summary: This update adds a bit of new content along with a round of fixes and improvements, a lot of it based on your feedback. A big focus was the lower graphics settings. The Low setting now looks much closer to High, and the game picks sensible settings for your PC on first launch instead of starting everyone on High. That should mean a smoother game without giving up much on looks. On the content side, you can now enter the tournaments you host with your own golfer, and your golfer keeps their score
